newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Jennings says Chia sells some stock.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Jennings says Chia sells some stock.

text.p: Home builder AV Jennings Homes Ltd said on Monday that it had agreed to place 19.5 million ordinary shares with institutional clients of brokerage firm Bell Securities and that its major shareholder Jack Chia Group had also sold about 10.2 million shares to Bell clients.
The company said the share issue at 56 cents each would raise about A$10.92 million while the Chia sale would reduce that Singapore-based group's stake to 70.11 percent from 82.32 percent.
AV Jennings shares ended six cents higher at 65 cents.
"The purpose of the placement is to repay debt and to provide additional working capital for the company," AV Jennings said.
"The directors consider that the combined effect of the placement and sell-down by the Jack Chia Group will create substantially more liquidity in the market for the company's shares."
